# Federation and Zharan Both "Welcome" Ibira Decision

NEW VELDRANIA — Within an hour of the announcement, both the Arennian embassy and the Zharani mission issued statements welcoming Kunasai's decision to develop the rare earths of the Tauá Hills, and offering, in nearly identical language, "technical partnership". Tarev's foreign ministry said nothing, which observers in the region considered the most informative response.
